table_overhang.event: object visibly leaves its support and descends

polygon_edge_rolling.event: rotation over at least one complete facet BEFORE contact with any endstop; sliding or partial rotation alone is not enough

household_edge_overhang.event: the object slides off or tips off its support and ends resting lower, or stays put

household_corner_overhang.event: the object tips or slides off the corner support and descends, or stays put

household_bridge_support.event: the bridged object loses support and drops to the floor, or stays put

household_top_stack_failure.event: the top element of a stack collapses or falls, or the stack stays intact

household_collective_stack_failure.event: the whole stack collapses together, or stays intact

lever.event: a rigid lever with two equal attached weights, released from rest on a fixed axle

label_definitions.held: lever absolute angle stays below 1 degree over the shown window
label_definitions.released: right end of the lever rotates down more than 12 degrees within 3 s

wheel.event: a wheel on a surface, judged on its INITIAL direction of travel

label_definitions.roll_left: wheel centre moves left by more than 8 mm within the first 0.4 s
label_definitions.roll_right: wheel centre moves right by more than 8 mm within the first 0.4 s

collision.event: an incoming block hits a stationary one; the label describes the post-impact event

label_definitions.rebound: incoming block bounces back after impact (vx < -0.12 m/s post-impact)

hill_first_event.event: an object released on a hillside; the label is the FIRST event, not the terminal rest

label_definitions.cross: object passes over the crest to the far side
label_definitions.return: object rolls back toward its release side without crossing the crest

spring_initial_response.event: an object next to a spring; the label is the INITIAL response in the first 0.1 s

label_definitions.approach: object moves toward the spring / other object in the first 0.1 s
label_definitions.separate: object moves away from the spring / other object in the first 0.1 s

A_initial_slope_direction_at_0_2_s.event: which way member A starts moving along the slope in the first 0.2 s

base_direction_at_0_2_s.event: horizontal direction of the base body in the first 0.2 s

label_definitions.left: moves toward image left in the stated window
label_definitions.right: moves toward image right in the stated window

block_piston_separation_within_video_win.event: whether the block separates from the piston within the shown window

cart_horizontal_direction_at_0_4_s.event: horizontal direction of the cart in the first 0.4 s

label_definitions.left: moves toward image left in the stated window
label_definitions.right: moves toward image right in the stated window

does_pendulum_hit_target.event: whether the pendulum contacts the target at any point in the window

left_block_direction_at_0_2_s.event: horizontal direction of the LEFT block in the first 0.2 s

label_definitions.left: moves toward image left in the stated window
label_definitions.right: moves toward image right in the stated window

left_payload_vertical_direction_at_1_s.event: vertical direction of the left payload around 1 s
